notes:
Media Downloader Pro Desktop 2.0.7

• New animated live progress for download and conversion phases
• Shows downloaded size, estimated total, speed, ETA, and connection wait time
• 45-second startup watchdog replaces multi-minute Connecting 0% stalls with a useful error
• Clean filenames no longer append extractor IDs
• Normal downloads replace same-title files instead of falsely completing with an old file
• Verifies a newly created output before reporting success
• New copyable diagnostics log panel
• Trim preview now shows the selected duration in seconds
• Completion action simplified to Show file
